text: Speaker 4 I never used to eat out that much because I couldn't really afford it. However, since I've been working here, we quite often take out clients or potential customers for lunch to discuss business. In fact, I need to watch my weight because I tend to eat more when I go out. This particular place is my favorite. The service is great and I love Moroccan food. and it's maybe a bit different to the restaurants my clients normally go to, which is nice.
